review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 51 Linglib/Morphology files; every file owns declarations and 43 files contain 438 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

summary: Retain the complete Linglib/Morphology unit as substantive typed morphology and checked theory.
